criteria.title: A red-team scan runs against the customer's AI app
criteria.statement: An automated scan with the predefined attack probes (prompt injection, jailbreak, data leakage, harmful content and more) runs against the customer's chatbot or a test AI app, with no code changes.
criteria.attest: A completed scan of the named AI app, with the probes it ran. Attach the scan report or a screenshot.

criteria.title: Findings are rated with remediation
criteria.statement: Each finding shows the attack, the app's reply, a severity, and how to fix it (prompt hardening, guardrails).
criteria.attest: The scan's findings list with severities and at least one remediation. Screenshot it.

criteria.title: AI Guard stops what the red team found
criteria.statement: Re-running the scan's successful attacks with AI Guard in front of the app blocks them (with AI Guard in the POV, its proxy or detection mode).
criteria.attest: The same attacks re-run with AI Guard in front, now blocked (AI Guard's logs or the second scan's report). Screenshot both.

criteria.title: Scans repeat on a schedule
criteria.statement: Scans re-run on a schedule or after the app changes, so new weaknesses are found without asking.
criteria.attest: A scheduled or recurring scan is set for the app. Screenshot its schedule.
